hacker_news.author: 1vuio0pswjnm7

hacker_news.title: Thorsten Ball – What I believe about the future of software development
hacker_news.author: Helithumper
hacker_news.summary:
This was originally posted on X and blew up. To plant my flag, to say that these are things I believed in September 2026, here it is on the blog, non-ephemeral. Some of these predictions are just observations, they’ve long been true at companies like Amp. Others will take some time to play out.

Code review will die. I mean: it’s already dead. But in the future, humans won’t find a bug or an issue with the code produced by a model, at least not in a reasonable time. Humans will only review the system and its composition, but it won’t be in PRs and it won’t be by looking through every line of the code.

Unit tests might die too. Why have training wheels if you never fall over? I’ve had models write 900 lines of Arduino C, compile it without a single error , and send it to the device, where the program ran perfectly. 900 lines will be nothing in the future.

hacker_news.title: Turning My PS3 into a Moonlight Streaming Host, and Building with LLMs
hacker_news.author: bruhfeefee
hacker_news.summary:
My PS3 on top of my NAS in my garage, with some other homelab nodes

I’ve been working a lot on my bespoke TV box lately (I’ll do a write-up on this Soon™). Think Android TV’s 10-foot UI, but built on NixOS , and with locally hosted streaming, emulation, and other games. It runs on a MINISFORUM mini-PC with integrated graphics, which handles emulation through the PS2 generation just fine. The PS3 poses two problems: at the time of writing, only ~79% of titles ar...

The simple solution would be to just plug my actual decade-old PS3 into the TV, jailbreak it so I could play ROMs off my NAS, and play that way. This, though, would mean switching TV inputs and controllers when going between my box and the PlayStation, and I figured I could come up with a solution that avoided that.

top_trends.title: Thorsten Ball – What I believe about the future of software development
top_trends.author: Helithumper
top_trends.summary:
This was originally posted on X and blew up. To plant my flag, to say that these are things I believed in September 2026, here it is on the blog, non-ephemeral. Some of these predictions are just observations, they’ve long been true at companies like Amp. Others will take some time to play out.

Code review will die. I mean: it’s already dead. But in the future, humans won’t find a bug or an issue with the code produced by a model, at least not in a reasonable time. Humans will only review the system and its composition, but it won’t be in PRs and it won’t be by looking through every line of the code.

Unit tests might die too. Why have training wheels if you never fall over? I’ve had models write 900 lines of Arduino C, compile it without a single error , and send it to the device, where the program ran perfectly. 900 lines will be nothing in the future.

source_briefs.content_summary: VoiceStudio 是一个完全本地运行的开源语音工具，可作为 ElevenLabs 的替代品，支持语音克隆、语音设计、视频配音、听写、转录及有声书制作，覆盖 646 种语言。使用 Python 开发，今日获得 3086 颗星，总星数 40086。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 开源、全本地化的多语言语音AI工具，降低了高质量语音生成和编辑的门槛，对隐私敏感和需要定制化的用户具有很大吸引力。

source_briefs.item_name: How to Know When the AI Boom Is About to Go Bust
source_briefs.content_summary: 《华尔街日报》的一篇文章探讨了如何判断当前的 AI 热潮何时会走向破灭，涉及金融和股票市场视角。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 在 AI 投资热潮中，开始出现对泡沫风险的预警和讨论，这是技术炒作周期中常见的反思阶段。

source_briefs.item_name: Thorsten Ball – What I believe about the future of software development
source_briefs.content_summary: 作者 Thorsten Ball 在 2026 年 9 月发表了对软件开发未来的预测。核心观点包括：代码审查（Code Review）将消亡，人类未来将只审查系统架构而非逐行代码；单元测试（Unit Tests）也可能消亡，因为 AI 生成的代码能够一次性编译并完美运行，例如他已有模型编写 900 行 Arduino C 代码并一次成功的经历。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这是一系列激进但基于当前 AI 编码能力的预测，挑战了传统的软件开发质量保障流程，可能引发关于工程师角色演变的深度讨论。

source_briefs.item_name: Is open source contribution still relevant?
source_briefs.content_summary: 一位曾为 OpenStack 和 Kubernetes 贡献过的开发者提问，在 AI 编码工具日益先进的今天，开源贡献是否仍有意义。Hacker News 上的评论认为，虽然需要处理大量 AI 生成的低质量内容（AI slop），但社区的核心体验并未发生根本性改变。
source_briefs.ai_comment: AI 辅助编码工具的普及正在改变开源社区的贡献生态，但人类在代码审查、架构设计和社区维护方面的核心作用短期内难以被完全替代。

source_briefs.item_name: A Trump 2024 Campaign Ad Returns, Now Brought to You by the Government - The New York Times
source_briefs.content_summary: 《纽约时报》等媒体报道，特朗普的一则 2024 年竞选广告以政府资助的形式再次播出。相关报道标题包括“白宫播放另一则政府资助的广告，特朗普警告‘最终战役’”、“特朗普政府开始播放最新一轮由纳税人资助的 2024 年特朗普竞选广告”。此事已引起两党 scrutiny（审查）。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 此事件涉及美国政治中竞选广告与政府公共宣传资金使用的界限问题，具有政治和伦理争议性。

source_briefs.item_name: Trump’s latest Mamdani lovefest comes at a bad time for Republicans - Politico
source_briefs.content_summary: Politico 等媒体报道了特朗普与一位名为 Mamdani 的人物之间不同寻常的友好关系。具体事件包括 Mamdani 在 Gracie Mansion 接待特朗普，唇语解读专家揭示了特朗普在纽约会面后对 Mamdani 做出的令人惊讶的提议。报道认为此事对共和党来说时机不佳。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 报道聚焦于特朗普的个人政治交往，这类关系网和互动可能影响其政治形象和选举策略。

source_briefs.item_name: UN ambassador Waltz says Iran was not negotiating ‘in good faith’ to end war - The Guardian
source_briefs.content_summary: 《卫报》等媒体报道，美国驻联合国大使 Waltz 指责伊朗未以“诚意”进行结束战争的谈判。独家报道称特朗普拒绝了伊朗的停火提议，并预计中期选举后将恢复轰炸。其他报道分析了特朗普拒绝伊朗休战提议、寻求“更好交易”背后的原因，以及此事对石油市场的影响。
source_briefs.ai_comment: 这反映了特朗普政府在伊朗问题上的强硬立场，将地缘政治策略与国内政治周期（中期选举）联系起来，并对国际能源市场产生即时影响。

summary.closing_note: 从智能体管理到记忆学习，从语音合成到办公集成，今日的开源热点凸显了AI工程化与实用化的强劲势头。开发者社区正通过协作创新，不断降低AI应用门槛并拓展其边界。然而，在关注技术热度的同时，也需理性评估项目的成熟度与长期价值。我们将持续追踪这些项目的进展与实际落地情况。
